findings.claim: Regex quote leakage remains unresolved for backticks. With const re = /`/; followed by a newline and // TODO: fix, the regex backtick survives the new quote reset and causes the real comment to be treated as template-string content.

Unconditionally resetting single/double quote state introduces false positives for valid JavaScript strings continued with a backslash-newline. A continued string whose next line starts with // TODO: text is now reported as a comment. Preserve quote state for genuine string continuations.
